prompt: Give a colour record a static factory that parses hex text plus derived accessors that compute values from its components. Complete fromHex, hex, brightness and isDark in RgbColor.
explanation: A static factory is the normal way to give a record an alternative, validating way in: fromHex does the parsing and error checking, then hands clean ints to the canonical constructor. hex(), brightness() and isDark() are derived accessors -- they add no state, they just compute from the components, and isDark() reuses brightness() instead of repeating the formula. Locale.US on String.format keeps %02X formatting identical on every machine.
hints: Handle null first, then strip a leading # with substring(1) before validating the remaining text.
A regular expression like "[0-9a-fA-F]{6}" is an easy length-and-content check; Integer.parseInt(pair, 16) turns each two-character pair into an int.
hex() is one String.format call with three %02X conversions, and isDark() should call brightness() rather than recomputing it.
